subject: Idea for ette hotel
body:
Hi,

I came across ette hotel and spent some time looking through the property. What stood out most was the custom soundscape design in the rooms — the idea that the sensory environment of the stay is as deliberate as the decor is a detail that no standard hotel content captures.

From what I saw, ette already has a strong visual identity, but I think the content could lean more into the guest experience of the stay — from arrival through the room to the Akira Back dining — so the viewer feels the full arc of being there, not just sees the space.

I create luxury travel UGC built around that kind of experience-led storytelling. The concept I had for ette would move from check-in through an evening at the property, using the art-forward rooms and pool atmosphere to make the stay feel immersive and aspirational.

Happy to send over the full angle I had in mind for ette hotel.

Best,
Malachi
